readings.title: The Four Chariots of Judgment
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH’s Spirits Subdue the Earth
readings.text: [Zechariah 6:1] And <dn>I</dn> lifted up <dn>My</dn> eyes again, and looked and saw four chariots coming from between two mountains, and the mountains were mountains of bronze. [2] With the first chariot were red horses, and with the second chariot black horses, [3] and with the third chariot white horses, and with the fourth chariot strong speckled horses. [4] So <dn>I</dn> responded and said to the messenger who was speaking to me, “What are these, my master?” [5] And the messenger answered and said to me, “These are four spirits of the heavens, coming forth from presenting themselves before the Master of all <dn>את</dn> the earth. [6] “The one with the black horses is going out to the land of the north, and the white ones have gone out after them, and the speckled ones have gone out to the land of the south.” [7] And the strong ones went out, eager to go, to walk to and fro in the earth. And <dn>He</dn> said, <dq>Go, walk to and fro in the earth.</dq> So they walked to and fro in the earth. [8] And <dn>He</dn> called to me, and spoke to me, saying, <dq>See, those who go toward the land of the north have given rest to <dn>My</dn> Spirit in the land of the north.</dq>

readings.title: The Crown of the High Priest
readings.subtitle: The Prophecy of the Branch and the Hěḵal
readings.text: [Zechariah 6:9] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [10] <dq>Receive <dn>את</dn> the gift from the exiles, from Ḥeldai, Toḇiyah, and Yeḏayah, who have come from Baḇel. Then you shall go the same day and enter the house of Yoshiyah son of Tsephanyah.</dq> [11] <dq>And you shall take <dn>את</dn> the silver and gold, make a crown, and set it on the head of Yehoshua the son of Yehotsaḏaq, the high priest,</dq> [12] <dq>and shall speak to him, saying, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, saying, “See, the Man whose name is the Branch! And from <dn>His</dn> place <dn>He</dn> shall branch out, and <dn>He</dn> shall build <dn>את</dn> the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [13] <dq>“It is <dn>He</dn> who is going to build <dn>את</dn> the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. It is <dn>He</dn> who is going to bear <dn>את</dn> the splendour. And <dn>He</dn> shall sit and rule on <dn>His</dn> throne, and shall be a priest on <dn>His</dn> throne, and the counsel of peace shall be between <dn>Them</dn> both,” ’</dq> [14] while the crown is for a remembrance in the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to Ḥělem, and to Toḇiyah, and to Yeḏayah, and to Ḥěn son of Tsephanyah. [15] <dq>“And those who are far away shall come and build <dn>את</dn> the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And you shall know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts has sent <dn>Me</dn> to you. And this shall be, if you diligently obey <dn>את</dn> the voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: The Prophets Ignite the Builders
readings.subtitle: The Divine Eye Protects the Elders of Yehuḏah
readings.text: [Ezra 5:1] Then the prophets, Ḥaggai the prophet and Zeḵaryah son of Iddo, prophesied to the Yehuḏim who were in Yehuḏah and Yerushalayim, in the Name of the <dn>Elah</dn> of Yisra’ěl upon them. [2] Then Zerubbaḇel son of She’alti’ěl and Yěshua son of Yotsaḏaq rose up and began to build <dn>את</dn> the House of <dn>Elah</dn> which is in Yerushalayim. And the prophets of <dn>Elah</dn> were with them, helping them. [3] At that time Tattenai the governor beyond the River and Shethar-Bozenai and their companions came to them and said this to them, “Who has made you a decree to build <dn>את</dn> this House and to complete <dn>את</dn> this wall?” [4] Then we told them what the names were of the men who were building this building. [5] And the eye of their <dn>Elah</dn> was upon the elders of the Yehuḏim, so that they could not make them cease until the matter went to Dareyavesh. And then they sent back a letter concerning this.

readings.title: The Governor’s Inquiry
readings.subtitle: Documenting the Reconstruction of the Great House
readings.text: [Ezra 5:6] This is a copy of the letter that Tattenai, governor beyond the River, had sent, and Shethar-Bozenai, and his companions the officials beyond the River, to Dareyavesh the sovereign. [7] They sent a letter to him, and this was written in it: To Dareyavesh the sovereign: All peace. [8] Let it be known to the sovereign that we went into the province of Yehuḏah, to the House of the great <dn>Elah</dn>, which is being built with heavy stones, and timber is being laid in the walls. And this work goes on speedily and is blessed in their hands. [9] Then we asked those elders, saying this to them, “Who made you a decree to build <dn>את</dn> this House and to complete <dn>את</dn> these walls?” [10] And we also asked them their names, in order to inform you, so we could write the names of the men at their head.

readings.title: The Defense of the Exiles
readings.subtitle: Appealing to the Decree of Sovereign Koresh
readings.text: [11] And this is the answer they gave us, saying, “We are the servants of the <dn>Elah</dn> of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding <dn>את</dn> the House that was built many years ago, which a great sovereign of Yisra’ěl built and completed. [12] “But because our fathers provoked <dn>את</dn> the <dn>Elah</dn> of heaven, <dn>He</dn> gave them into the hand of Neḇuḵaḏnetstsar sovereign of Baḇel, the Kasdaia, who destroyed <dn>את</dn> this House and exiled <dn>את</dn> the people to Baḇel. [13] “But in the first year of Koresh sovereign of Baḇel, Koresh the sovereign made a decree to build <dn>את</dn> this House of <dn>Elah</dn>. [14] “And also, <dn>את</dn> the gold and silver utensils of the House of <dn>Elah</dn>, which Neḇuḵaḏnetstsar had taken from the Hěḵal that was in Yerushalayim and brought to the hěḵal of Baḇel, those Sovereign Koresh took from the hěḵal of Baḇel and they were given to one named Shěshbatstsar, whom he had made governor, [15] and said to him, ‘Take <dn>את</dn> these utensils, go, deposit them in the Hěḵal in Yerushalayim, and let the House of <dn>Elah</dn> be built on its place.’ [16] “Then the same Shěshbatstsar came, laid <dn>את</dn> the foundation of the House of <dn>Elah</dn> which is in Yerushalayim, and since that time even until now it has been in building, and it is not completed.” [17] And now, if it seems good to the sovereign, let a search be made in the sovereign’s treasure-house, which is there in Baḇel, whether it is so that a decree was made by Sovereign Koresh to build <dn>את</dn> this House of <dn>Elah</dn> at Yerushalayim, and let the sovereign send us his decision concerning this.

readings.title: The Scroll of Aḥmetha
readings.subtitle: Koresh's Authorization to Rebuild and Restore
readings.text: [Ezra 6:1] Then Dareyavesh the sovereign made a decree, and a search was made in the house of the books wherein also the treasures of Baḇel were kept. [2] And at Aḥmetha, in the palace which is in the province of Media, a scroll was found, and this was written in it: [3] In the first year of Sovereign Koresh, Sovereign Koresh made a decree concerning the House of <dn>Elah</dn> at Yerushalayim, “Let the house be built in the place where they brought offerings, and its foundations strongly laid, its height sixty cubits, its width sixty cubits, [4] three rows of heavy stones and one row of new timber. Let the expenses be paid from the sovereign’s house. [5] “And let <dn>את</dn> the gold and silver utensils of the House of <dn>Elah</dn>, which Neḇuḵaḏnetstsar took from the Hěḵal which is in Yerushalayim and brought to Baḇel, be returned and go to the Hěḵal which is in Yerushalayim, to its place, and deposit them in the House of <dn>Elah</dn>,”

readings.title: Dareyavesh Enforces the Covenant
readings.subtitle: The Wealth of the Nations Funds the Hěḵal
readings.text: [6] Now, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, and Shethar-Bozenai, and your companions the officials beyond the River, stay away from there. [7] Leave <dn>את</dn> the work of this House of <dn>Elah</dn> alone. Let the governor of the Yehuḏim and the elders of the Yehuḏim build <dn>את</dn> this House of <dn>Elah</dn> on its place. [8] And <dn>I</dn> make a decree as to what you should do for the elders of these Yehuḏim, for the building of this House of <dn>Elah</dn>: Let the exact expense be paid to these men from the sovereign’s resources, out of the taxes beyond the River, so that they are not stopped. [9] And whatever they need – both young bulls and rams, and lambs for the ascending offerings of the <dn>Elah</dn> of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the request of the priests who are in Yerushalayim – let it be given them day by day without fail, [10] so that they bring pleasing offerings to the <dn>Elah</dn> of heaven, and pray for the life of the sovereign and his sons. [11] And <dn>I</dn> make a decree that whoever changes this word, let a timber be pulled from his house, and let him be impaled, hanged on it. And let his house be made a dunghill because of this. [12] And <dn>Elah</dn>, who has caused <dn>His</dn> Name to dwell there does overthrow any sovereign or people who put their hand to change, to destroy <dn>את</dn> this House of <dn>Elah</dn> which is in Yerushalayim! <dn>I</dn> Dareyavesh make the decree – let it be done promptly.

readings.subsection: The Apex of the Second Era
readings.title: The Completion of the House
readings.subtitle: Blessed by the Prophets and the Decrees of Sovereigns
readings.text: [Ezra 6:13] Then Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shethar-Bozenai, and their companions promptly did according to what Dareyavesh the sovereign had sent. [14] And the elders of the Yehuḏim were building, and they were blessed through the prophesying of Ḥaggai the prophet and Zeḵaryah son of Iddo. And they built and finished it, according to the decree of the <dn>Elah</dn> of Yisra’ěl, and according to the decree of Koresh, and Dareyavesh, and Artaḥshashta sovereign of Persia.

readings.title: Interrogating the Motives of the Fast
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH Rejects Self-Serving Traditions
readings.text: [Zechariah 7:1] And in the fourth year of Sovereign Dareyavesh it came to be that the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to Zeḵaryah, on the fourth of the ninth new moon, Kislěv. [2] Now Běyth Ěl had sent Shar’etser, with Reḡem-Meleḵ and his men, to pray before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, [3] speaking to the priests who belonged to the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, “Should <dn>I</dn> weep in the fifth new moon and fast as <dn>I</dn> have done for so many years?” [4] Then the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts came to me, saying, [5] <dq>“Speak to all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and lamented in the fifth and seventh months all these seventy years, did you truly fast for <dn>Me</dn> – for <dn>Me</dn>?</dq> [6] <dq>And when you ate and when you drank, was it not for those eating and for those drinking?</dq> [7] <dq>Are these not the words which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> proclaimed through the former prophets when Yerushalayim and the cities around it were inhabited and in safety, and the South and the low country were inhabited?’ ”</dq>

readings.subsection: The True Currency of the Kingdom
readings.title: The Mandate for Right-Ruling and Compassion
readings.subtitle: The Historic Consequence of a Flint Heart
readings.text: [Zechariah 7:8] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to Zeḵaryah, saying, [9] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘Execute true right-ruling, show loving-commitment and compassion everyone to his brother.</dq> [10] <dq>“Do not oppress <dn>את</dn> the widow or the fatherless, the stranger or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’</dq> [11] <dq>“But they refused to listen, and they shrugged their shoulders, and stopped their ears from hearing.</dq> [12] <dq>“And they made their hearts like flint against hearing <dn>את</dn> the Torah, and <dn>את</dn> the words, which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts had sent by <dn>His</dn> Spirit through the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.</dq> [13] <dq>“And it came to be: as <dn>He</dn> called and they did not hear, so let them call, but <dn>I</dn> shall not hear,” said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.</dq> [14] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> scattered them with a storm wind among all the nations which they had not known. And the land was laid waste behind them, no one passing through or returning, for they made <dn>את</dn> the pleasant land a waste.”</dq>

readings.subsection: The Return of the Divine Presence
readings.title: Jealousy for Tsiyon
readings.subtitle: The City of Truth and the Gathered Remnant
readings.text: [Zechariah 8:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts came, saying, [2] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘<dn>I</dn> shall be jealous for Tsiyon with great jealousy, with great wrath <dn>I</dn> shall be jealous for her.’</dq> [3] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, ‘<dn>I</dn> shall return to Tsiyon, and <dn>I</dn> shall dwell in the midst of Yerushalayim. And Yerushalayim shall be called: City of the Truth, and the Mountain of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, the Set-apart Mountain.’</dq> [4] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘Again old men and old women shall dwell in the streets of Yerushalayim, each one with his staff in his hand because of great age,</dq> [5] <dq>and the streets of the city shall be filled with boys and girls playing in its streets.’</dq> [6] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘If it is marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in <dn>My</dn> eyes?’ declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.</dq> [7] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘See, <dn>I</dn> am saving <dn>My</dn> people from the land of the sunrise and from the land of the sunset.</dq> [8] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall bring them back, and they shall dwell in the midst of Yerushalayim. And they shall be <dn>My</dn> people, and <dn>I</dn> shall be their <dn>Elohim</dn>, in truth and in righteousness.’</dq>

readings.subsection: From Adversarial Curse to Premial Blessing
readings.title: The Sowing of Peace
readings.subtitle: Strengthening the Hands for the Divine Economy
readings.text: [Zechariah 8:9] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘Let your hands be strong, you who are listening in these days to these words, from the mouth of the prophets, of the day the foundation was laid for the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, the Hěḵal that was to be rebuilt.</dq> [10] <dq>For before these days there was not a wage for a man, nor a hire for beast, and there was no peace for him who went out or came in, because of his enemies, and <dn>I</dn> set all men one against another.</dq> [11] <dq>But now <dn>I</dn> am not as in the former days to the remnant of this people,’ declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.</dq> [12] <dq>Because of the sowing of peace the vine does give its fruit, the ground does give her increase, and the heavens do give their dew. And <dn>I</dn> shall cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these.</dq> [13] <dq>And it shall be, as you were a curse among the nations, O house of Yehuḏah and house of Yisra’ěl, so <dn>I</dn> shall save you, and you shall be a blessing. Do not fear, let your hands be strong.’</dq> [14] <dq>“For thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘As <dn>I</dn> purposed to do evil to you when your fathers provoked <dn>Me</dn>,’ declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ’and <dn>I</dn> did not relent,</dq> [15] <dq>so again in these days <dn>I</dn> have purposed to do good to Yerushalayim and to the house of Yehuḏah. Do not fear!</dq> [16] <dq>These are the words you should do: speak <dn>את</dn> the truth to one another, judge with truth and right-ruling for peace in your gates.</dq> [17] <dq>And do not plot evil in your heart against another, and do not love a false oath. For all these <dn>I</dn> hate,’ declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: Appointed Times of Joy and Gladness
readings.subtitle: The World Takes Hold of the Yehuḏi
readings.text: [Zechariah 8:18] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts came to me, saying, [19] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘The fast of the fourth, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth months, are to be joy and gladness, and pleasant appointed times for the house of Yehuḏah – and they shall love <dn>את</dn> the truth and <dn>את</dn> the peace.’</dq> [20] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘Peoples shall yet come, inhabitants of many cities,</dq> [21] <dq>and the inhabitants of the one go to another, saying, “Let us earnestly go and pray before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. <dn>I</dn> myself am going.”</dq> [22] <dq>And many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts in Yerushalayim, and to pray before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’</dq> [23] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘In those days ten men from all languages of the nations take hold, yes, they shall take hold of the edge of the garment of a man, a Yehuḏi, saying, “Let us go with you, for we have heard that <dn>Elohim</dn> is with you.” ’ ”</dq>
